== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Sources used:
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20041216041335/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Endor_Regional_2004.htm From Rebels to Mavericks: 2005 Endor Regional Weekend] (capture 16 December 2004)
* SWCCG 2005 Worlds Qualifiers Listing (events.htm, capture 28 August 2005) and Kangas's forum post t=4063 (capture 16 December 2004), both reused as already cited on [[2005 World Championship]], [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] and [[David Kangas]]
* New page. Winner from Kangas's PC forum post (already cited on [[David Kangas]]); bye holders and the Virtual Card design (asterisk) from the PC qualifier listing.
* Missing data: attendance, full standings, decklists, and James Sheldon's place (the announcement gave byes to the top two, but the listing gives bye holders, not places, so his place is left blank).
* Missing data: the announcement page is undated; it was written before the weekend of 22–24 October 2004, so the citation says October 2004.
* Left out: the organizer's personal email address and the shop's phone number.
